negative_opposition: Encoded Im z1<-.01 and observed action=advance; exact one-step Shapley decomposition against relay.
fresh_holdouts: Old training plus fresh block0 to fresh block1; separate whole fresh-category holdout removes all equal numeric observations.
sensitivity: Main fit retains old A; separately report exclusion of only the old A cohort, never discard new A.
virtual: Six matched initial configurations, N=17/33, K=.04/.06/.10/.15, 300 steps; models fixed before calculations. Raw numeric distances are diagnostics, not support guarantees.
